legend.0: No human angle: a product, system, or company action with no person or community affected
legend.1: A faint human angle: people are mentioned but the story is mainly about technology or business
legend.2: A clear human angle: a person's experience, a creative or ethical dispute, or an effect on a community
legend.3: A strong human story that most people would want to read or discuss, with personal stakes, creativity, fairness, or surprise

legend.0: Full of jargon, product names, or abbreviations that a layperson cannot decode
legend.1: Mostly technical wording; a layperson would get only a vague idea
legend.2: A layperson understands the gist, though a term or two is unfamiliar
legend.3: Plain language; anyone can tell what happened

legend.0: No effect on ordinary people is stated
legend.1: An effect on ordinary people is only implied or merely possible
legend.2: A concrete effect on some ordinary people is stated
legend.3: A concrete effect on many ordinary people's daily lives is stated
